fact: Biometric Update reports Cabo Verde issues a Unique Identification Number to every child born, within a national ID system its presenters call the backbone of future authentication.

The Autentika portal says citizens authenticate to services with the smart-card Cartão Nacional de Identificação (CNI) and its PIN, and that the CNI is activated in person at registry offices, the Casa do Cidadão and consulates.

The National Identification Card was created by the State through Decree-Law 19/2014 and is compulsory for all Cabo Verdean citizens from age 4, with applications taking 7 to 15 days, per the Consular Portal.
The Consular Portal says the National Identification Card (CNI) can be ordered online with photo and signature captured, a normal order costing 14 euro and an urgent one 20 euro.
IMIJ states SNIAC has contributed to issuing about 631,720 national identity cards (CNI), 513,862 electronic passports and 14,235 residence permits since its implementation.
IMIJ's project page says the SNIAC national identification system is operational and issues the national ID card (215,189 issued by Q2 2021), the e-passport and the foreign residents' permit.
system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
